Name: Prismatic_SnS
Author: fw007
Description:
This Mod Adds Scuffed Compatability between Sword & Sorcery and Prismatic Tools Continued by adding an Upgrade Path from Prismatic to either Stygium or Blessed Tools configurable via Config and Generic Mod config Menu.

This is my first ever mod and was made without any knowledge of Programming and with extensive help from Chat GPT.

As the mod is very Scuffed i was unable to create a Visual Representation of what Materials are needed for the Upgrade in Clint's shop.


The Stygian Tools each Require 5 Stygian Bars and 35000 Gold
The Blessed Tools each Require 1 DuskspireHeart and 50000 Gold


I'm unsure if i'm going to Impróve this mod anymore thus i'll Upload my Project to Github, so that others can use it and Improve it.
once it is Uploaded i will add the Link to it here.
